versionTitle: 版本三：潮汕金漆木雕·屋脊嵌瓷·佛山潮州木版年画在地非遗风 (Chaoshan Gilded Woodcarving, Porcelain Inlay & Folk Woodcut)
title: 时迁舞蛇·引队灵动角色
prompt: Authentic Chaoshan intangible cultural heritage craft aesthetic: a synthesis of Chaozhou多层镂空 gilded woodcarving (潮州金漆木雕), iridescent Chaoshan rooftop porcelain-shard inlay (嵌瓷), and traditional Teochew polychrome woodblock printmaking (木版年画). Color harmony anchored in South China Sea indigo (#1B2A32), auspicious Chaoshan vermilion (#B63B2A), pure 24k gold leaf (#E0AE4E), and shell-lime white (#F2ECE1). Crisp carved relief edges, tactile ceramic and woodgrain textures, curated 1:1 square gallery framing with generous clean breathing room, strictly no text, no letters, no watermark. Subject: The agile Scout character (时迁) in Chaoshan Yingge Dance, wearing a swallow-tail headscarf and holding a coiled cloth serpent prop, guiding the formation.
